signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: Capacity Limitations means maximum Event capacity as stipulated in an Order Form; in the absence of a specific agreement in an Order Form, a limitation of 100 million Events shall apply;

Usage Limitations mean any limitations that Services are or may be subject to, including, but not limited to, the number of users, contacts, e-mails/SMS, IP addresses, scenarios, imports or any other limitations pursuant to the respective Order Form or Guide.

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 7 reviews (4.2% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: I reached out for support but got no responses
We did not get any support at all anymore.

signals.label: Review trend
signals.finding: Newest 20 reviews average 2.5/5 vs 4.43/5 all-time (-1.93). 12% of all reviews are 1-2 stars.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The cheapest tier is a usable slice of the product.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $49 vs a stated $2640 regular price (98% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: Hey Oliver shall be entitled to, at its sole discretion, determine the methods and means for performing the Services and developing any related deliverables.

claims.text: Hey Oliver works with websites to build customized campaigns, track engagement and convert leads

quote.text: Hey Oliver is marketing automation software that works seamlessly with your website so you can build customized campaigns, track engagement, and convert more leads.

claims.text: Turns website visitors into customers with targeted marketing campaigns

quote.text: Hey Oliver helps you turn website visitors into customers with targeted marketing campaigns.

claims.text: Can create campaigns based on visitor actions and custom parameters for personalized experience

quote.text: With the capability to create campaigns based on visitor actions and custom parameters, you can create a fully personalized experience for your leads based on how engaged they are.

claims.text: Measures actions, events and user interactions to track KPIs and customize campaigns

quote.text: Hey Oliver makes it easy to measure specific actions, events, and user interactions so you can track KPIs and customize targeted campaigns with your most engaged visitors.

claims.text: Visitor activity is logged and visible in marketing dashboard on each visit

quote.text: Each time someone visits your website, their activity is logged and can be seen in your marketing dashboard.

claims.text: Dashboard shows website activity, running campaigns, leads generated and popular pages

quote.text: See an overview of the website activity, how many campaigns are running, the number of leads generated, and the most popular pages.

claims.text: Can track website metrics and see currently live visitors in real-time

quote.text: You can also track your website metrics and see the visitors who are currently live on your site in real-time with Hey Oliver.

claims.text: Automatically stores visitors referrals, clicks, downloads and page views

quote.text: Hey Oliver automatically stores visitors’ referrals, clicks, downloads, page views, and more.

claims.text: Analyzes visitors and enables segmentation by predetermined or custom criteria for targeted campaigns

quote.text: It analyzes each visitor and provides you with data that you can use to segment your visitors based on predetermined or custom criteria and set up targeted campaigns to engage them.

claims.text: Outreach flows through Bubbly as part of Hey Oliver

quote.text: Your outreach to website visitors all flows through Bubbly as part of Hey Oliver.

claims.text: Bubbly can be used to chat, push shoutout campaigns and provide customer service

quote.text: Bubbly does it all—you can use it to chat, push shoutout campaigns, provide customer service, and more.

claims.text: Bubbly is fully customizable to align with brand colors and style

quote.text: Bubbly by Hey Oliver is fully customizable and can be edited to align with your brand colors and style.

claims.text: Codes must be redeemed within 60 days of purchase

quote.text: You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase

claims.text: Codes 11 and beyond add 5 websites per code

quote.text: Codes 11+ continue to increase by 5 websites per code

finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers face a default cap of 100 million Events if no other limit is agreed.

quote.text: Capacity Limitations means maximum Event capacity as stipulated in an Order Form; in the absence of a specific agreement in an Order Form, a limitation of 100 million Events shall apply;

finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers can be limited on users, contacts, emails/SMS, IPs and other usage dimensions.

quote.text: Usage Limitations mean any limitations that Services are or may be subject to, including, but not limited to, the number of users, contacts, e-mails/SMS, IP addresses, scenarios, imports or any other limitations pursuant to the respective Order Form or Guide.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers should compare team-member allowances since paid plans limit users per account.

quote.text: Create multiple users with different login details for your Hey Oliver account

finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers get a 60-day money-back guarantee if they terminate early in the term.

quote.text: If the Customer terminates the Agreement for whatever reason within the first sixty (60) days after the commencement of the Term, Hey Oliver shall refund to the Customer all Subscription Fees already paid for the Subscription Services.

finePrint.summary: Outside any special agreement, lifetime-deal buyers should assume payments are non-cancellable and non-refundable.

quote.text: payment obligations are non-cancellable and the Fees paid are non- refundable.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers should know the vendor can unilaterally decide how tailored services are performed.

quote.text: Hey Oliver shall be entitled to, at its sole discretion, determine the methods and means for performing the Services and developing any related deliverables.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers risk suspension if amounts remain overdue by 30 days or more.

quote.text: If any amount owing by the Customer under this or any other agreement for the Services is overdue by thirty (30) or more days, Hey Oliver may, without limiting its other rights and remedies, suspend the provision of the Services to the Customer until such amounts are paid in full.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers risk account hold or termination for system abuse such as spam or scraping.

quote.text: where a user account abuses the system because of his/hers own end or their visitor's end, such as spam, website scraping or illegal content, Hey Oliver shall notify the Customer for this behavior and may hold or terminate the account until the issue is fixed.

finePrint.summary: Reassuringly, neither side is allowed to terminate the agreement without cause.

quote.text: For the avoidance of doubts, neither Party is entitled to terminate this Agreement without cause.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers only get reasonable efforts to be notified of outages lasting over four hours.

quote.text: Hey Oliver shall undertake reasonable endeavours to notify the Customer of scheduled and unscheduled network outages that are expected to last for more than four (4) hours and that may affect the Services.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers should compare support tiers since basic support is ticket support via email and forms.

quote.text: Enjoy support from our team via email and contact forms

finePrint.summary: The comparable Plus plan normally costs €69 per month.

quote.text: Engage and convert visitors with our basic suite of tools. get Plus for €69/mo

finePrint.summary: The comparable Premium plan normally costs €99 per month.

quote.text: Enjoy our full suite of product and cutting edge solutions. get Premium for €99/mo

finePrint.summary: The comparable Enterprise plan normally costs €199 per month.

quote.text: Stellar results with dedicated support and higher usage limits. get Enterprise €199/mo

trials.claim: Codes 11 and beyond add 5 websites per code
trials.claimQuote: Codes 11+ continue to increase by 5 websites per code
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence to confirm or contradict the website increase for codes 11 and beyond.

trials.claim: Hey Oliver works with websites to build customized campaigns, track engagement and convert leads
trials.claimQuote: Hey Oliver is marketing automation software that works seamlessly with your website so you can build customized campaigns, track engagement, and convert more leads.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report the tracker and pop-up no longer work and the software is dead, and that promised features do not work and bugs halt workflow. This directly conflicts with the claim that it works with websites to track engagement and convert leads.

exhibits.quote: This software are no longer working its dead, there tracker and pop-up bubble no longer work.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the tracker and pop-up functionality no longer works, contradicting that it works with websites to track and convert.

exhibits.quote: The features that were promised don't seem to work as intended, and I've encountered multiple bugs that completely halt my workflow.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports promised features do not work as intended and bugs halt workflow, undermining the claimed functionality.

exhibits.quote: Hey Oliver works with any website or eCommerce platform regardless of the technology used
exhibits.argument: This confirms the software works with websites as claimed.

exhibits.quote: The marketing automation software that helps your business grow faster, convert more visitors, and run automated, targeted and personalized marketing campaigns.
exhibits.argument: This confirms it builds customized campaigns and converts leads.

trials.claim: Turns website visitors into customers with targeted marketing campaigns
trials.claimQuote: Hey Oliver helps you turn website visitors into customers with targeted marketing campaigns.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report marketing features are full of bugs, audience counting does not work, and the information is glitchy and wrong. This materially undercuts the claim of turning visitors into customers with targeted campaigns.

exhibits.quote: marketing features are full of bugs - even counting the size of user groups / audiences doesn't work
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports marketing features are buggy and audience counting fails, undermining targeted campaign conversion.

exhibits.quote: It's glitchy and buggy and gives wrong information.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the tracking data is glitchy and wrong, undermining turning visitors into customers.

exhibits.quote: Learn more about your visitors' interests and preferences, and send them personalized campaigns to convert them into leads.
exhibits.argument: This confirms turning visitors into customers with campaigns.

exhibits.quote: Hey Oliver allows you to create targeted, personalized and engaging campaigns at scale.
exhibits.argument: This confirms the campaigns are targeted marketing campaigns.

trials.claim: Can create campaigns based on visitor actions and custom parameters for personalized experience
trials.claimQuote: With the capability to create campaigns based on visitor actions and custom parameters, you can create a fully personalized experience for your leads based on how engaged they are.
trials.reasoning: The vendor states campaigns use deep behavioral analysis on more than 25 criteria, actions and custom attributes, and custom tracking tags like amount of purchases. The reviews about lead-form fields do not contradict that campaign targeting capability.

exhibits.quote: We NEED the ability to ask for more details, like Name, Phone & Email in order to reach out to these leads.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports inability to collect custom details beyond basic contact, undermining fully personalized campaigns.

exhibits.quote: we can only ask for email OR phone number (Not Both - Not even a Name).
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports campaigns are limited to email or phone only, contradicting custom-parameter personalization.

exhibits.quote: Deep behavioral analysis on more than 25 criteria, forms, actions and custom attributes
exhibits.argument: This confirms campaigns can use visitor actions and custom parameters.

exhibits.quote: Create your own tracking tags like "amount of purchases" or "items in basket"
exhibits.argument: This confirms custom parameters for personalized tracking.
